applicability.rationale: The report makes a comparison across retained studies, so its documented query, screening, and extraction choices are relevant to assessing the claim.
The manuscript is a systematic review and describes study screening, making a study-selection flow artifact applicable.
The abstract makes a synthetic comparison claim based on 31 summarized studies.

evidence_anchor.claim: The manuscript omits full-text exclusion counts and reasons, although the retained screening log contains them.
evidence_anchor.locator: Methods: “The manuscript omits full-text exclusion counts and reasons even though the log contains them.”

remedy.cost_tradeoffs: Requires reporting and checking the retained screening-log information; it does not require new screening, though it may expose record inconsistencies that need clarification.
remedy.minimum_action: Add a complete study-selection flow artifact and accompanying text that reports the retained full-text exclusion counts and reasons, reconciling them with the screening log.

findings.scholarly_relevance: Without these retained selection details, readers cannot fully audit how the included evidence set was produced. This weakens transparency in an implementation choice relevant to the synthesis claim; the flow criterion independently identifies the missing reporting artifact but is advisory.
